exercises.title: Абзац 1
exercises.goal: Суцільний текст. Якщо точність падає — зменш темп, а не кількість уваги.
texts: Touch typing is a lot like playing the piano. First your fingers learn scales: short, simple, repeated moves. Then the moves turn into words, and later into whole sentences. Do not rush. A steady rhythm and accuracy bring speed on their own.

texts: Sit up straight and place your fingers on the home row. Your index fingers feel the small bumps on two keys. After every press the finger returns to its place. Your eyes stay on the screen while your hands remember the way.

texts: The town is still asleep in the early morning. The streets are quiet, and only a cleaner sweeps leaves near the bus stop. Then the bakery opens, and the air smells of fresh bread. People hurry to work, and the new day picks up its pace.

texts: You do not need a special talent to learn something new. You need patience and a short lesson every day. Twenty minutes of careful work give more than two hours of hurry. A mistake is not a problem: it shows what to repeat.

exercises.title: Абзац 6
